issues.description: In problem_statement.md the task is described as a single change in helloWorld.asm: rename the invalid register "ecc" to "ecx" so the program compiles. However, solution_repository/helloWorld.asm changes more than that by adding an extra printf argument ("push 123") while keeping the original stack cleanup ("add esp, 4"). This diverges from the stated task scope and also leaves the solution with inconsistent printf argument/stack handling compared to the template (one pushed argument).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the described task by only changing "add eax, ecc" to "add eax, ecx" and keep the original printf call sequence (push hello; call printf; add esp, 4). If you intentionally want an additional printf argument, update the problem statement accordingly and fix the stack cleanup to "add esp, 8" (and ensure argument order matches the intended format string).
